segments.text: Ok so, this is the quickstart page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Microsoft Agent Framework, dot net. And umm, I have implemented this page in my project.
This is my project, with the server dot ts, main dot ts and app dot vue from the doc, copied as they are.

Moving on to the demo. So I asked the chat which agent framework it is, and uh, it does answer, but from the built-in OpenAI agent, not Microsoft Agent Framework, dot net. No step on this page ever connects a Microsoft Agent Framework, dot net agent.
So the Vue quickstart link opens the Microsoft Agent Framework, dot net landing page, all about React.
And the only code it shows is a Next.js route handler, export const post equals handler. That's not Vue at all.
So basically, the Vue steps are only in the markdown export, and they use the built-in OpenAI agent, never a Microsoft Agent Framework, dot net agent.
So yeah, this needs fixing, please have a look at it.
